### CFG — Earnings momentum continues

**Reported GAAP diluted EPS of $1.41 beat the prior quarter's $1.30 by $0.11**, an 8% sequential increase. Net income available to common shareholders increased to $599 million from $554 million [B0048, B0052]. No company-designated aggregate notable-item EPS adjustment was identified.

**Revenue and margin:** Net interest income increased $44 million to $1,675 million, and FTE NIM expanded 2 basis points to 3.19%. Management attributed improvement to lower terminated-swap impacts and fixed-rate asset repricing, partly offset by funding costs [B0040, B0055, B0112]. Noninterest income declined $5 million to $647 million, while noninterest expense was essentially flat at $1,393 million. The efficiency ratio improved to 60.0% [B0041, B0043, B0057].

**Credit:** Provision declined to $125 million from $134 million. Net charge-offs totaled $137 million, with the annualized ratio stable at 0.37%. ACL coverage was 1.47% [B0045, B0282, B0069, B0065].

**Capital and returns:** CET1 stood at 10.5%, ROTCE reached 15.1%, and tangible book value was $35.78 per share. Citizens repurchased $125 million of shares [B0061, B0058, B0258, B0272].

**Outlook:** Management projected fourth-quarter NII growth of approximately 2.5%–3%, noninterest income growth of 4%–5%, expense growth around 1%, and stable-to-slightly-lower charge-offs [B0454].

**Investment thesis:** Incrementally positive. Improving spread income, operating efficiency and profitability support the earnings-growth case, although funding costs and credit normalization remain important monitoring points.
